ungated.name: Abyssal Sire
ungated.reason: It lives in the Abyssal Nexus, which you reach through the Abyss or by fairy ring, and no tracked area covers it.

ungated.name: Barracuda Trials
ungated.reason: The trials are raced at sea, in waters the tracker has no area for.

ungated.name: Forestry
ungated.reason: Its events can appear wherever you cut suitable trees, so no single area opens it.

ungated.name: Impetuous Impulses
ungated.reason: It is played in Puro-Puro, which you enter through the crop circle in Zanaris or one that turns up in wheat fields around the world, so no single area opens it.

ungated.name: Mahogany Homes
ungated.reason: Its contracts send you to homes in Falador, Varrock, East Ardougne and Hosidius, so no single area opens it.

ungated.name: Mimic
ungated.reason: You fight it in Watson's house in Hosidius, but only once an elite or master clue casket turns out to be a Mimic, so no area opens it on its own.

ungated.name: Shooting Stars
ungated.reason: Stars crash at random spots all over the world, so no one area holds them.
